items.title: Исходные архивы сохранены в библиотеке
items.evidence: one.7z, two.7z, three.7z и four.7z подтверждены в /Нейро Курису/Исходники/ с исходными байтами и именами.

items.title: Единая release metadata line
items.evidence: Root/runtime manifests, lockfiles, ReleaseContract, SUPER_VERSION and integration manifest aligned to WorkPass48 / 35.69.0 / schema 225.

items.title: Инициатива получает предметные темы из целей и памяти
items.evidence: OrganismCore passes active goals and evidence-backed pattern/goal-learning/self-model memories to the existing initiative engine.

items.title: Новизна тем и защита от циклических повторов
items.evidence: Fourteen-day token-overlap near-duplicate suppression, candidate dedupe and no generic fallback when all candidates are duplicates; focused queue regression passes.

items.title: Appraisal-linked expression
items.evidence: Existing emotion appraisal maps to a confidence-gated transient toneHint; prompt keeps stable Kurisu identity, does not reveal telemetry and does not authorize tools. Shared sanitization rejects common credential/medical-secret patterns and contact/phone-like values in candidate topics and autonomous recent-memory context; it is a targeted filter, not a universal PII detector.

items.title: Правдивая модель доставки и взаимности
items.evidence: A UI delivery ACK marks only delivery/execution; it no longer increases reciprocity. Test asserts unchanged reciprocity after delivery.

items.title: Runtime typecheck and focused tests
items.evidence: npm run test:workpass48 passes typecheck, autonomous queue, prompt and trait-salience tests.

items.title: Legacy integration regressions
items.evidence: big-pass-229-233 personhood/restart test and big-pass-288 social consolidation test pass after correcting outdated fixture assumptions.

items.title: Server import and UI/API linkage
items.evidence: server relative import audit checks 11 imports; UI/API linkage reports 127 routes, 49 runtime atlas surfaces and no missing required seams.

items.title: Provider-backed self-initiated dialogue idle/restart E2E
items.evidence: Queue and prompt contracts are tested but there is no long live provider/UI run in this environment.
items.nextStep: Run with installed dependencies and a real configured language provider; observe idle initiation, restart and replay; continue provider-side data minimization review.

items.title: Production app build and browser Live2D E2E
items.evidence: App dependencies are absent; production Vite build and interactive browser E2E were not verified.
items.nextStep: Install through canonical project installer, build app and run browser tests including fallback and UI message delivery.

items.title: True audio-to-avatar viseme/lipsync
items.evidence: Existing intent/state mapping drives gaze/head motion; no verified audio envelope or phoneme/viseme path was added here.
items.nextStep: Connect a real audio/viseme source to the canonical avatar body mapping.

items.title: Full source archive integration and license sign-off
items.evidence: Four archives are preserved and 21 unique nested source ZIPs were inventoried in previous review; this pass did not claim line-by-line integration of every upstream source.
items.nextStep: Integrate the next source only when it closes a concrete missing capability, with license/provenance and single-owner review.

items.title: Real receipt → Reafference → temporal credit → checkpoint
items.evidence: WorkPass51 integrates exact decision-targeted Reafference/temporal credit and persists independently reconciled external outcomes as MemoryOS2 episodes with P33 feedback; physical provider/device proof, provider-side idempotency and live environment validation remain open.
items.nextStep: Verify with a real external provider/device adapter, reconnect/replay and ambiguous-result scenarios; then validate end-to-end causal learning on independent tasks.

items.title: Recall privacy gate shared by all three provider prompt routes
items.evidence: Normal cognitive, autonomous-dialogue and cognitive-proposal prompt paths now sanitize stored memory summaries, known-entity fact statements and world facts; unsafe facts are omitted as whole records.

items.title: Unsafe restored proactive messages and generated output fail closed
items.evidence: Persisted unsafe topics/messages are stripped and pending work is deferred; unsafe generated unsolicited text cannot be marked ready for UI delivery.

items.title: Privacy regression coverage across retrieval, prompt and restore seams
items.evidence: Focused regressions cover secret/API-key patterns and email-like data in all recalled context classes, old persisted queue state and outgoing proactive text; safe context remains available.

items.title: Universal privacy classification and explicit cloud-context policy
items.evidence: A shared heuristic gate covers known credential/contact patterns; it is not a complete PII detector or a user-consent policy for every provider.
items.nextStep: Implement classification, local/cloud policy and network-level evidence.

items.title: Production Vite build and interactive browser/Live2D E2E
items.evidence: Still not run because app dependencies are absent in the current work environment.
items.nextStep: Install from lockfile in an environment with dependencies and execute actual browser E2E.

items.title: Real provider/device receipt to Reafference and temporal credit
items.evidence: WorkPass51 integrates exact decision-targeted Reafference/temporal credit and persists independently reconciled external outcomes as MemoryOS2 episodes with P33 feedback; physical provider/device proof, provider-side idempotency and live environment validation remain open.
items.nextStep: Verify with a real external provider/device adapter, reconnect/replay and ambiguous-result scenarios; then validate end-to-end causal learning on independent tasks.

items.title: Actual audio/viseme Live2D synchronization
items.evidence: State-linked motion selection exists; real audio-envelope/viseme source and browser proof remain open.
items.nextStep: Connect actual TTS playback audio to mouth parameters and test finish/cancel.

items.title: Independent labelled memory retrieval holdout
items.evidence: Current documented retrieval uplift is zero and no candidate is promoted.
items.nextStep: Build fixed independent labelled set and compare end-task outcomes.

items.title: Target-host local inference profile
items.evidence: llama.cpp adapter exists but real target-hardware inference and performance are unverified.
items.nextStep: Benchmark latency, memory, thermal and no-cloud-fallback behavior on target host.

items.title: Единый контур интересов, целей, памяти и реакции пользователя
items.evidence: OrganismCore derives candidate themes from active goals, evidence-backed memory and self-authored goals; P33 owns graded interest profiles; explicit thread-linked positive/engaged/negative feedback updates the matching profile idempotently with source/evidence IDs. Affect and selected profile context reach autonomous dialogue generation.
items.nextStep: Run a live provider idle dialogue to evaluate topic quality and long-run stability.

items.title: Фоновый autonomous scheduler до durable delivery/restart
items.evidence: Deterministic provider test exercises actual OrganismRuntime background clock -> cognitive cycle -> language-provider seam -> ready message -> UI acknowledgement -> explicit response feedback -> durable flush -> restart with no redelivery. Sensor-only cycles preserve social quiet-time.
items.nextStep: Repeat with installed application and an actual configured provider in a real browser.

items.title: Opt-in browser speech with state-driven Live2D movement and mouth mapping
items.evidence: AvatarStage implements opt-in SpeechSynthesis, voice choice, cancel paths, word-boundary mouth-shape approximation, and sends emotion/gaze/thinking/gesture/motion to Live2D viewer. Actual production browser and audio timing were not available in this environment.
items.nextStep: Run Vite production build and browser/Live2D E2E; replace word-boundary approximation with audio/phoneme sync when output provider supplies timing.

items.title: Exact decision attribution and explicit capacity expiry in temporal credit
items.evidence: CanonicalTemporalCreditAuthority excludes outcomes targeted to another decision and expires overflowed unresolved decisions with zero eligibility/confidence; focused cross-decision leakage and overflow regressions pass.

items.title: Independent external evidence gate for Reafference
items.evidence: Positive match is rejected when independent support is zero or reconciliation is not supported/corroborated; high confidence alone cannot manufacture independent evidence. Focused codec tests pass.

items.title: Verified external action outcome to canonical episodic memory
items.evidence: Exact-decision, independently reconciled and non-replayed external outcomes are admitted to the single MemoryOS2 as provenance-linked episodic facts, then update canonical P33 interest evidence idempotently. Persistence/restart integration passes.

items.title: Intent-aware MemoryOS2 query ranking
items.evidence: Bilingual query intent gives bounded kind/context fit for episodic, procedural, identity, goal, causal and factual queries. Controlled same-lexical fixtures pass; broad retrieval benchmark has recallDelta=0 and candidate is not promoted.

items.title: Project step completion requires qualified evidence
items.evidence: AutonomousProjectExecutor returns a completion result only after tool/step identity, research gates, threshold evidence and minimum qualified attempts pass. Core progress/skill promotion cannot use an incomplete attempt.

items.title: Persisted qualifying-attempt count
items.evidence: qualifyingAttempts is stored in the project plan and sanitized on restore. Weak evidence does not satisfy multi-attempt promotion policy. Legacy snapshots safely default to zero.

items.title: Outcome-ID binding gates and quality-aware retry
items.evidence: Outcome IDs are consumed only after project/tool/step/research-gate checks pass; low evidence receives bounded retry/backoff and no fitness or promotion bonus.

items.title: Project execution state exposed in runtime/UI
items.evidence: The existing active-project endpoint includes a sanitized read-only plan-status view; Runtime Atlas renders progress, per-step gates, qualifying attempts and blockers without exposing tool input.

items.title: Production browser validation of project progress panel
items.evidence: Runtime typecheck and route/linkage contracts pass; installed React/Vite production build and interactive browser E2E are not established in this environment.
items.nextStep: Run installed app build and interactive browser E2E in the full app environment.

items.title: Canonical persisted one-time action approval gate
items.evidence: ActionGateway binds exact tool/input/operation and decision lineage, expires tickets, serializes ticket admission and one-time consumption, persists state and denies altered/replayed approvals.

items.title: Owner approval UI can retry the exact protected action
items.evidence: Operator Console safely renders redacted approval previews, resolves owner decision and re-submits the captured exact voice/outbound operation once; Runtime Atlas retains the global review queue.

items.title: Direct voice, modern/legacy outbound, and research probe routes protected
items.evidence: Missing approval blocks these direct surfaces before voice capture, outbound envelope creation or Python probe execution; actual local runtime + bridge E2E confirmed approval and replay-denial.

items.title: Approval preview data minimization improved
items.evidence: Bearer credentials, secret query parameters, URL userinfo, email and phone-like strings are redacted from public approval previews; full request fingerprint stays private.

items.title: Production app and actual provider/device E2E
items.evidence: App dependency tree is absent; production Vite/browser E2E and live provider/device side effects were not executed.
items.nextStep: Install using npm run install:all in an allowed environment, run app production build/browser E2E and validate protected operations against real adapters.

items.title: Universal approval continuation in app root
items.evidence: Structured approvalRequired POST responses with replayable JSON-object bodies register safe metadata in the global ActionApprovalCenter; original body remains only in the current tab closure.

items.title: Exact replay after approval
items.evidence: Owner approval resolves the canonical ActionGateway ticket, then replays the same route and same JSON object once with approvalId; preview is never used to reconstruct inputs.

items.title: Single approval decision UI
items.evidence: Runtime Atlas became read-only for approval decisions so a second panel cannot consume a ticket while the active client call is waiting to resume.

items.title: Approval continuation broker lifecycle
items.evidence: Broker tests cover publish, approve-once, decline, duplicate live ticket, ticket expiry and automatic pending-call expiry; malformed/out-of-contract expiry is rejected before a UI card is created, and sensitive bodies are never persisted.

items.title: Source-derived fail-closed approval UX
items.evidence: The retained MIT Hexis approval policy and tests informed the no-approver-means-no-consent flow; implicit CHAT approval was deliberately not copied.

items.title: Production Vite build and browser E2E
items.evidence: App dependencies are not installed in the work environment; source TSX transpilation and route-wiring checks are not equivalent to a real browser session.
items.nextStep: Install app lockfile in a clean network-enabled environment and run real approval journey tests.

items.title: Approval ticket orphan cleanup on reload
items.evidence: Global ActionApprovalCenter polls the canonical ActionGateway permission snapshot and displays unclaimed server-pending tickets after a short race-avoidance grace interval. The owner can explicitly decline an orphan. Raw request body is not persisted and no action is resumed after tab reload.

items.title: Bilingual, concept-aware MemoryOS2 retrieval for paraphrased interests, goals, causes and identity questions
items.evidence: Added pre-tokenized bilingual concept groups, balanced expansion across active topics, identity intent for curiosity/personality prompts and controlled Russian-to-English recall examples. MemoryOS2/MemoryFabric remain the sole canonical memory owner; broad labelled holdout has not proved uplift and the candidate is not promoted.
items.nextStep: Build a frozen independent Russian/English paraphrase holdout with sufficient hard negatives; compare against BM25 with Recall@k, MRR, false recalls and p95 latency; only promote if it beats the baseline.

items.title: Safe discovery and explicit revocation of orphaned approval tickets after page reload
items.evidence: ActionApprovalCenter fetches server-owned permission snapshots, filters pending tickets without an in-tab continuation, shows a redacted preview and allows explicit decline only. Sensitive original request bodies remain ephemeral and orphaned tickets are never auto-executed.

items.title: Balanced expansion and cached concept tokens in bilingual retrieval
items.evidence: Concept aliases are tokenized once at module initialization; multi-concept queries round-robin their bounded expansion terms in relevance order rather than truncating alphabetically, protecting active secondary concepts. Runtime typecheck and focused retrieval scenarios pass.
